subject: StellarDevs — usage health, latency constraints, and expansion playbook
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <t.harris@stellardevs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Kline <a.kline@stellardevs.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: StellarDevs — post-call summary: usage health, latency constraints, and next steps

Hi Tom / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. High level: you’re seeing predictable growth in support/chat workloads, an intermittent latency spike tied to longer contexts, and rising token spend from RAG jobs — all while needing predictable performance for SLAs.

Key pain points (from call)
- Latency spikes ~500–800ms during peak windows for 8k+ token requests (impacting 3 customer-facing endpoints).
- Cost concentration: ~65% of token spend from nightly batch RAG and embeddings refresh jobs.
- KV cache misses on multi-turn sessions — cache warm-up time adds tail latency.
- Procurement timeline: procurement wants clear pilot scope & cost delta to approve a Dedicated pilot before EoQ.

Goals you stated
- Reduce 95th pct latency below 350ms for interactive endpoints.
- Cut unit token cost for RAG pipeline by 20–30% without quality regressions.
- Get pilot approved (Dedicated reserved pool) to validate throughput and deterministic latency.

Recommended next steps (owning parties and ETA)
1) Pilot scope doc: Redwood to send a 1‑page pilot runbook (Jasmine) — due Mon 7/12.
2) Usage snapshot + cost baseline: StellarDevs to share last 30 days CSV (Aisha) — target Mon 7/12.
3) Technical deep-dive: 60min session to review KV usage and batching options (Marissa + Eng) — schedule week of 7/19.
4) Procurement ask: preliminary pricing delta and SLA targets for pilot (Jasmine) — draft Wed 7/14.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short draft pilot scope and the usage snapshot we exported from the call (CSV).

If that all looks right, I’ll send the one-pager and we can lock the technical deep-dive slot. Thanks again — excited to get you into a pilot and validate predictable latency.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: pilot_scope-draft-v1.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: stellardevs-usage-snapshot-q2.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: StellarDevs — post-call summary: usage health, latency constraints, and next steps

Thanks for the clear notes, Jasmine — good capture. One small add: during the call Tom mentioned an internal compliance checkpoint around retention (30 days max) for embeddings — that will affect how we recommend caching strategies. Can you add that to the pilot runbook (acceptance criteria)?

Also flagging that I’ll bring a systems engineer to the 7/19 deep-dive to walk through batching and KV cache tuning.

-Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Compliance: yes, 30-day retention on all embeddings and intermediate payloads.
- Procurement: Contracts will need an estimated monthly cost delta for a 3-month pilot vs. current hosted usage. They prefer a capped spend estimate.

We’ll share the 30-day usage CSV by EOD Monday (Aisha will drop it in the Drive link).

Tom
VP Product | StellarDevs

Subject: StellarDevs — pilot runbook and next steps (scheduling deep-dive)

Tom / Aisha / Contracts team —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Attached is the 1‑page pilot runbook (pilot_scope-draft-v1.pdf) and a short pricing delta snapshot based on your rough monthly token volume (high-level estimate only). Key points:
- Pilot: 3 weeks, Dedicated 2x A100-equivalent throughput pool, objectives to validate 95th pct latency <350ms and 20–25% per-token cost reduction for nightly RAG batches.
- Compliance: runbook updated with 30-day embeddings retention and audit hooks.
- Pricing: capped pilot spend estimate provided (see attached). Final numbers will be in a formal quote once we have the 30-day CSV.

Action items now:
1) Aisha to upload the 30-day usage CSV to the linked Drive item (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_pilot-scope) — ETA Mon 7/12 EOD.
2) Jasmine to coordinate deep-dive calendar with Marissa & Eng — propose Tue 7/20 or Wed 7/21.
3) Contracts: if you want a shortened SOW template for procurement review, I can share a redline-friendly doc by Wed 7/14.

I’ll follow up with calendar invites once we confirm the deep-dive slot. If anyone needs the pilot scope adjusted (throughput, retention window, or acceptance criteria), shout here and I’ll update.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in motion.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192
